items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I played Tiny Tim’s wedding you know.

ctx.x: What’s the goofiest thing that ever happened to you in the music business? Is it possible for you to remember that?
Well I don’t know goofy, but I played Tiny Tim’s wedding you know.
